entities.name: Vít Jedlička
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Vít Jedlička is a Czech right-wing libertarian politician, publicist, and activist. He was the chairman of the Party of Free Citizens in the Hradec Králové Region and serves as the founder and chairman of the Czech voluntary association Reformy.cz. On 13 April 2015, he founded the libertarian capitalist micronation of Liberland, claiming a patch of land that is part of the Croatia–Serbia border dispute, and on the day the micronation was founded, was named president by a committee he appointed.
